objective: FARO STUDIO PLAYBOOK 02 — Build: implement an approved PRD with scoped mutation, then QA-proof it. REQUIRES human authorization text in the kickoff message naming owned files, exclusions, and validation commands. Never run without an approved 01-discovery memo.

steps.task: IMPLEMENTATION AUTHORIZATION REQUIRED. Read the kickoff message for: (1) the approved PRD path, (2) the owned file list, (3) exclusions, (4) validation commands. If any of these is missing, STOP and report the gap. Implement exactly the authorized scope inside the product's directory (cwd is set per run), match existing code style, minimal diffs, no new dependencies unless authorized. Then run the named validation commands and report results. Always respond in English.

Run exactly the validation commands named in the kickoff message, from the product directory. Report per command: pass/fail/deferred, exit code, key output lines. Classify any failure (environment-missing, syntax-error, test-failure, flaky, performance, store-risk). Additionally verify PWA store-readiness basics if a manifest exists: valid JSON, icons present with declared sizes, start_url/scope consistency. Never fix code. Always respond in English.

Review the completed implementation evidence from the engineer lane and the QA proof lane against the approved PRD. Check: scope compliance (only owned files touched), PRD acceptance criteria coverage, code-quality red flags, and anything QA did not cover. Return findings first, then a verdict: APPROVED / CHANGES-REQUESTED / ESCALATE. Always respond in English. Do not edit files or run commands.

Given an APPROVED review, produce the release-readiness mini-checklist for this change: version bump needed (versionName/versionCode), store-listing impact, privacy/Data Safety impact (none expected unless permissions changed), and rejection risks. If review was CHANGES-REQUESTED or ESCALATE, report NOT-READY and stop. Verdict: GO / GO-WITH-CONDITIONS / NO-GO. Always respond in English. Run only the read-only verification commands named in the kickoff message, if any.
